page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title lines in large capitals at the top; a woodcut ornament in the middle; imprint lines below it. Strong mirrored show-through from the reverse side runs across the whole page. The narrow strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title page is heavily overprinted by mirrored show-through from the reverse, so most lines cannot be read letter by letter and are marked illegible. The readings "IN DANIELEM PROPHETAM", "COMMENTARII", "CHRISTI THEOLOGO" and "nunc primum opera IOANNIS MOLERI" are tentative; the mirrored "Apollonii ad Hebraeos" line may belong to the reverse. The woodcut in the centre is an ornamental border/cut and is not transcribed. The imprint at the foot (place, year, printer) is largely illegible. No page number, running head or signature is visible. The right-edge strip is the neighbouring page and is excluded.
